test_sparse_min_max: test the _sparse_min_max function to compute min and max values of a sparse matrix along a given axis
test_sparse_nan_min_max: test the _sparse_nan_min_max function to compute nan-aware min and max values of a sparse matrix along a given axis
test_mode: test the _mode function to compute the mode of an array with scipy.stats.mode across a specified axis
test_sparse_linalg_cg: test the _sparse_linalg_cg function to solve sparse linear systems using the conjugate gradient method
test_get_additional_lbfgs_options_dict: test the _get_additional_lbfgs_options_dict function to conditionally add lbfgs solver options based on scipy version
